parsed.rationale: All 16 participating records are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists and a `shared_field_count` of 1, meaning the only structural similarity is that each is a zero-member type alias. The names are entirely unrelated domain concepts — `ConfettiView`, `DebugHUD`, `DialADJPage`, `HeightReader`, `InfoDetailView`, `PlaycutLoadingSection`, `TalksetView`, `WXYCLogo`, etc. — spread across at least seven distinct packages (`DebugPanel`, `WXUI`, `Wallpaper`, `PartyHorn`, `PlayerHeaderView`, `MusicShareKit`, `app:WatchXYC`, `app:iOS`). The coincidence is purely structural: the pipeline flagged them because they share the same AST shape (a type alias with no members), not because they encode the same concept. Consolidating unrelated view-alias declarations from different packages would introduce artificial coupling with no semantic benefit.
